mandatory_scope.process: Epoxy resin filling, planarization and copper cap, with solderable ENIG surface. Preserve plated barrel and existing GND connections. Not simple ink tenting/plugging.
mandatory_scope.planarity: Must provide flat, continuous solderable surface compatible with 0.10mm stencil; obtain supplier finished cap recess/protrusion specification, do not assume all generic POFV quality classes meet print-transfer needs.
mandatory_scope.do_not_change: Do not remove EPAD/PGND paste or copper, do not remove these thermal vias, do not cover solderable thermal-pad area with soldermask as a substitute.

other_vias.default_design_requirement: Tented according to supplied mask; no mandatory fill/cap on module EPAD because it is unprinted. Near-pad vias are being relocated by separate rework.
other_vias.factory_all_via_process: Factory may require an order-wide fill/cap process rather than selecting only 11 holes. This is compatible with native via electrical function but changes actual process scope and price; explicit production review required. No claim of selective pricing/availability.

coordinate_convention: Absolute KiCad mm, +Y down; CAM uses negative Y. UUID ties positions to the source board.
factory_capability_basis: https://www.jlc.com/portal/vtechnology.html (2026-11-14): epoxy/copper filling and cap, cap copper >=10um, via hole .15-.55mm.

registration_margin_target.meaning: Project layout margin, not a published factory worst-case guarantee. Hole position tolerance is separate; no numerical mask registration tolerance was found on current capability pages.
registration_margin_target.ink_plug_boundary: International capability page requires >=.35mm from other mask openings for ink plugging; .20mm target does not establish eligibility for ink plugging.

r10_applicability: All 11 retained via UUIDs, coordinates, hole diameters and GND nets checked against final r10; mask and thermal pads unchanged.
